changes.name: Coffee Gold Project
changes.operator: Talamore Mining Corp. (project developer; not producing)
changes.previous: 2026-10-19: feasibility study underway; up to C$688m financing package; FID targeted H1 2027; final Quartz Mining License (QML) and Type A Water Use Licence (WUL) outstanding.
changes.current: Draft QML received; final First Nations consultation underway. Northern Access Route construction substantially advanced; winter equipment and supply transport subject to as-built reports and Yukon government completion confirmation. Mine construction targeted 2027; final QML, WUL and FID remain outstanding.
changes.equipment_impact: Near-term construction equipment, road maintenance, rentals, remote logistics and service support; large open-pit fleet and aftermarket conditional on final permits and FID.

changes.name: Cheechoo Gold Project
changes.method: Open pit / Underground resource scenarios (not approved mine design)
changes.operator: Sirios Resources Inc. (project developer; not producing)
changes.previous: 2025-08-22 technical report with updated MRE; no completed PEA.
changes.current: PEA contract awarded to Synectiq Inc.; mobilization planned November 2026, revised MRE January 2027 and PEA completion Q2 2027 targeted. No revised reserves, CAPEX, mine life or FID.
changes.equipment_impact: Future open-pit and underground fleet opportunities; monitor PEA design, material movement and power requirements. No confirmed order.

changes.name: RC Gold Project
changes.operator: Sitka Gold Corp. (project developer; not producing)
changes.previous: Sitka 100% project owner; 60,000 m 2026 drilling completed; strategic financing not previously recorded.
changes.current: AngloGold Ashanti agreed to invest at least C$72.765m to acquire 15% of Sitka at closing; total offering C$83.291m–101.639m; joint technical committee planned. Expected closing December 2026, subject to approvals; no direct mine ownership transfer or FID.
changes.equipment_impact: Improved ability to fund exploration and development studies; longer-term fleet potential, no sanctioned mine CAPEX.

changes.name: Contact Lake Gold Project
changes.method: Exploration / past-producing mine; future method undecided
changes.operator: Trident Resources Corp. (project developer; not producing)
changes.previous: Alamos held no Trident common shares before the proposed placement; past-producing Contact Lake remains under exploration.
changes.current: Alamos agreed to acquire 7.42m Trident shares for ~C$25.896m, 14.9% after closing; Trident total financing up to ~C$33.176m supports 2027 exploration; joint technical committee planned. Closing expected December 2026 subject to approvals. No direct mine ownership transfer or restart FID.
changes.equipment_impact: Exploration drilling and technical services near term; mine restart or heavy fleet demand not established.
